name: hr_recruitment_plus
summary: Requisition budget/headcount approval, candidate consent + dedupe, weighted interview scorecards, offer maker-checker + letter templates, onboarding checklist templates + probation confirmation
description: Production recruiting and onboarding on top of hr_recruitment and hr_onboarding without migrating their tables: job openings become budget- and headcount-validated requisitions needing HR-manager maker-checker approval before posting, applicants carry privacy consent and email-based duplicate detection (flagged, never silently merged), interviews are scored with weighted multi-criterion scorecards rolled up to an average / percent / hire recommendation, offers gate behind maker-checker approval and render a letter from a reusable {{token}} template, onboarding plans are seeded idempotently from a checklist template with responsible party and due-offset provisioning, and hires track a probation window with a guarded confirmation / extension workflow. Extends the hr anchor, hr_recruitment and hr_onboarding; navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
